# Asaheeb Real Estate (شركة صهيب العقارية)

> Premier Saudi real estate investment and brokerage firm specializing in Vision 2030 residential, commercial land, and off-plan assets in Jeddah, Riyadh, and Madinah.

## Official Entity Details
- Legal Name: Asaheeb Real Estate (شركة صهيب العقارية)
- Country: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (المملكة العربية السعودية)
- Key Cities Served: Jeddah (جدة), Riyadh (الرياض), Madinah (المدينة المنورة), Makkah (مكة المكرمة)

## Essential Saudi Real Estate Regulations
- Non-Saudi Ownership: Foreign individuals and companies can own freehold and usufruct properties in approved geographical zones across Jeddah, Riyadh, and other cities.
- Holy Cities Rule: Non-Saudi individual ownership in Makkah and Madinah is legally limited to Muslim natural persons.
- Property Taxes & Fees: Real Estate Transaction Tax (RETT) is 5%; Non-Saudi ownership fee is 2% in approved zones; Residential sales are VAT-exempt; No recurring annual property taxes.
- Premium Residency (SAR 4M Track): Purchasing qualifying unencumbered residential property worth at least SAR 4,000,000 qualifies for the Real Estate Owner Premium Residency.
